results.summary: An apartment in developer standard in a modern complex in Gdańsk's Śródmieście, presented as an investment property for short- and long-term rental. The layout consists of a living room with a kitchenette and a bathroom. Above-ground and underground parking spaces are available at the complex, and a parking space can be bought.

An apartment of 142,73 m2 on the 4th floor of a new development in Gdańsk's Młode Miasto, near the Motława. It has a living room with a kitchenette, four bedrooms, three bathrooms, a wardrobe, a winter garden and a large terrace. The building offers common areas finished to a high standard, monitoring and access control, an underground garage, storage units and commercial premises.

An apartment in developer standard in a modern complex in Gdańsk's Śródmieście, offered as an investment property for short- and long-term rental. It comprises a living room with a kitchenette and a bathroom. The complex has monitoring and security, common areas finished to a high standard, and above-ground and underground parking spaces.

An apartment of 33,52 m2 in the Młode Miasto district of Gdańsk, by the Motława and a few minutes' walk from the historic centre. It has a living room with a kitchenette, a hall, a bathroom and a balcony of 5,06 m2. The development includes monitoring and access control, an underground garage, storage units and commercial premises.

An apartment of 45,05 m2 in the Młode Miasto district of Gdańsk, by the Motława and a few minutes' walk from the historic centre. It comprises a living room with a kitchenette, a bedroom, a bathroom, a hall and a balcony of 6,68 m2. The development offers monitoring and access control, an underground garage, storage units and commercial premises.

A move-in ready two-room apartment of 37,14 m² on the ground floor of a tenement house on Waryńskiego Street in Gdańsk's Dolny Wrzeszcz. It has a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen, a bathroom and a hallway, and underwent a comprehensive renovation about 10 years ago including replacement of all installations. The property is gated and fenced with resident-only parking in the courtyard, and a basement belongs to the flat; built-in wardrobes and furniture are included in the price, excluding the sofas.

results.summary: An apartment on the top storey of a small estate on a green hill in Gdańsk, with 99,19 m2 of living space and a 54,81 m2 mezzanine and a view of the Old Town. It is offered in developer standard and includes a balcony of 11,84 m2, a sheltered terrace of 17,14 m2 and a storage unit in the price. The estate has a residents' club and fitness room, playground, green roofs and photovoltaic panels, a gated and monitored area, a lift and an underground garage.

results.summary: A two-room investment apartment in Gdańsk Aniołki, handed over finished, furnished and equipped and ready for collection. Units of 1 to 3 rooms with areas from 36,68 to 63,14 m² are available in the same building, which holds 65 apartments, commercial premises, a garage hall and a reception. The sale is subject to 23% VAT, and parking spaces and storage units can be bought additionally.

results.summary: A two-room apartment of 38,00 m2 in Gdańsk's Przymorze district, on the 1st floor of a 10-storey block built in 1975. It comprises a living room with access to a balcony, a bedroom, a kitchen, a bathroom, a hallway and a vestibule, and requires a full renovation; a basement belongs to the flat. The building has an intercom, a renovated and monitored staircase and a lift, with district heating and hot water.

features.quote: Na poszczególne kondygnacje dostaniemy się też dzięki windzie.

results.summary: An apartment of 128,3 m² on the Marina Primore estate in Gdańsk Przymorze, with a terrace and a sea view from every room. It has a spacious living room, a separate kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms with underfloor heating and a wardrobe in the hallway, and is fully furnished and equipped. The building has 2 lifts, monitoring and a round-the-clock porter's lodge; 2 places in the garage hall are offered for 150 000 zł and a storage unit of 3,1 m² is included in the price.

features.quote: Wysoki standard wykończenia i pełne wyposażenie.
